notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) succeeded for discovery - robots.txt (200, standard Shopify, no anthropic-ai/Claude disallow) and sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (200, 299 collection URLs) fetched via requests. Raw HTML of collection pages showed the mega-menu submenu and the Wizzy search/filter app's product grid + count as JS-lazy-loaded (empty/placeholder in static HTML), so escalated to tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium, domcontentloaded + 5-6s settle wait) to read each collection's rendered H1/breadcrumb, its 'N Products' count, and its own '.subcategory-listing' image-tile widget (this theme's native declared subcategory nav, independent of the hover mega-menu). No blocks encountered at any tier; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: built from union of sitemap_collections_1.xml + top nav (Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Home Textile, Flowers & Greens, Bar & Drinkware, Faux Leather, Gift, Sale) + each page's own subcategory-listing widget. Home Textile(37 total)->Cushion Covers(37, itself further split by Type/Shape filter-collections: Embroidered/Printed/Solid/Square/Rectangular)+Cushion Inserts(0). Bath & More(47 total, reachable via its own subcategory-listing though not a top-nav item)->Bath Accessories(22)/Bath Towels(4)/Bath Mats(3)/Wicker Accessories(8). Faux Leather(28 total)->Faux Leather Accessories(21)/Storage and Organisers(5)/Office Collection(4). Kitchen & Dining(124 total)->Cutlery/Dinnerware/Tea & Coffee/Table Accessories(26)->Table Napkin(14)/Napkin Rings/Placemats(11). Home Decor(343 total)->Decoratives(->Photo Frames/Figurines/Canisters/Decorative Platters/Decorative Bowls/Decorative Jars/Decor Objects)/Candle Stands/Home Fragrances/Scented Candles/Vases - none textile or storage. Also checked ~20 additional sitemap-only collections that sounded textile/storage relevant but are not linked from any nav/subcategory-listing widget found (storage-box, wicker-storage-box, storage-utility-jars, jewellery-organisers, magazine-basket, organisers, pen-stand, watch-box, laundry-basket, decorative-boxes, storage-essentials, baskets, bed-linen, bedsheet-and-quilt, pillow-shams, throws, quilts, towels, vanity-pouches): all were confirmed either 0-product empty-state pages or exact-duplicate/overlapping subsets of a node already counted, EXCEPT 'Wicker Baskets' (6 products: laundry basket, 3x utility baskets, bin, heather baskets - i.e. exactly the storage-purpose subset of the excluded 'Wicker Accessories' bucket, none of which overlap an already-included row), which was included in Storage since it uniquely captures genuine storage items not represented elsewhere. QTY: exact 'N Products' header text as rendered by the Wizzy widget after JS hydration, or its explicit 'We couldn't find any Products for this Collection!' empty-state mapped to qty=0. EXCLUDED and why: Bath Accessories(22) - all bathroom fixtures (pedal dustbins, toothbrush holders, soap dish/dispenser, vanity mirrors), no textile/storage items, excluded per Bathroom Fixtures boundary. Wicker Accessories(8) - mixed bucket of 2 decorative wicker trays + 6 storage baskets/bin; excluded as a whole generic 'Accessories' node in favor of the clean 'Wicker Baskets' storage-only collection counted separately. Faux Leather Accessories(21, serving trays/coasters/photo frames) and Office Collection(4: coasters+dustbin+pen stand+watch box, the latter two already fully represented in Storage and Organisers) - decorative or fully-redundant, excluded. Napkin Rings - metal tableware, not textile. Cutlery/Dinnerware/Tea & Coffee - tableware, not textile/storage. Decoratives/Candle Stands/Home Fragrances/Scented Candles/Vases - purely decorative, not textile/storage. No populated Bedding/Curtains/Rugs/Blankets/Quilts/Throws/Bed Linen/Pillow Shams/Duvet/Sheet categories exist live on this site (bed-linen, quilts, pillow-shams, throws, bedsheet-and-quilt collections all checked and confirmed 0 products) - PHL's live textile range is currently limited to Cushion Covers, Cushion Inserts, Bath Towels, Bath Mats, Table Napkins and Placemats. Placemats(11) included in Textile per the site's own 'Table Textiles' category naming though its product mix is 4 cotton + 7 PVC (confidence MEDIUM, flagged).
